other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Global statistics (such as medians for imputation, categorical frequencies, TF-IDF vocabularies, and K-Means centroids) are computed on the entire training dataset before it is split into cross-validation folds. This causes information from the validation folds to leak into the training folds during the CV process, which can lead to overly optimistic out-of-fold validation scores.

summary: The agent demonstrates excellent data science practices, producing a highly robust and sophisticated solution. It employs rigorous handling of geospatial, categorical, and text features, correctly avoids train/test leakage by fitting transformations only on the training set, and uses a carefully constructed 5-fold cross-validation strategy with out-of-fold blending. The only minor flaw is cross-validation data leakage: unsupervised transformations and imputations are fit on the full training set before the CV loop, which slightly biases the out-of-fold validation scores.
